summary_en: Annual dividend raised to 20.00 yen per share from 16.00 yen forecast (4.00 yen increase), effective end of fiscal year December 2026, as earnings guidance was raised on higher-than-planned per-engagement rates.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Full-Year Earnings Forecast and Revision of Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Unite and Grow Inc. raised its annual dividend forecast for fiscal year ending December 2026 to 20.00 yen per share from the previously announced 16.00 yen per share, representing an increase of 4.00 yen. This dividend increase is linked to upward revisions of the company's earnings guidance.

The company revised its full-year earnings forecast based on better-than-planned per-engagement rates and strong performance from its specialized "Accounting IT" service launched in the current period. Net profit per share was raised to 65.66 yen from 61.44 yen previously forecast, with full-year net profit increased to 520 million yen from 485 million yen. The dividend increase reflects the company's dividend policy of targeting a 30% payout ratio and 5% return on equity (DOE) while maintaining stable distributions to shareholders.

The period examined covers the fiscal year from January 1, 2026 to December 31, 2026. The company had conducted a 2-for-1 stock split effective July 1, 2025.
